newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua June sugar exports dwarf 1996.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua June sugar exports dwarf 1996.

text.p: Sugar shipments out of the Brazilian port of Paranagua in June totaled 155,374 tonnes, dramatically higher than the 45,283 tonnes exported from the port in the same month last year, the port authority said.
Of this year's total, 97,863 tonnes were bagged sugar and 57,511 tonnes bulk. In June last year, the split was 17,484 tonnes bagged and 27,799 tonnes bulk.
The higher shipments are due to deliveries of 260,000 long tons of Paranagua raws against the New York May contract which should be completed by the middle of July.
In May this year, the port handled exports of 90,987 tonnes of sugar, again substantially higher than the 11,595 tonnes exported in May 1996.
